Energia.name: Energia
Energia.summary: Offers unparalleled firepower and strong defenses, but their dependency on energy requires careful planning. Without energy, their units become weak and vulnerable.

MechaniX.name: MechaniX
MechaniX.summary: Has the advantage of automation and sheer numbers, but their units lack flexibility and mobility. They are best suited for large-scale battles.

XenoBio.name: XenoBio
XenoBio.summary: Provides adaptability and powerful evolution options, making them excellent for fluid, dynamic playstyles, but they require more micromanagement and strategic planning.
